name: [4 PLAYER RALLY] WRONG WAY!
desc:
One drives. One navigates. Both panic.

🏁 Co-op rally: the driver steers, the co-driver reads the pace notes, yells the calls and pulls the handbrake
🤖 Solo? Drive with a robot co-driver (5 voices!) or yell at a robot driver
🏆 Championships, daily & weekly stages, races and elimination
🌩️ Night, snow, fog, thunderstorms… and sheep on the road
🎟️ Rally Pass, crew grades, titles and badges
🎨 Paints, helmets, visors, exhaust flames, dash toys and more

No mic needed: quick calls for every corner.
Trust your navigator.
